==Biography==

== Trivia ==
* He and his longtime teammate [[Ceros]] have the distinction of being tied for the second-longest continuous tenure of any player with a single organization, behind only [[Faker]], who joined [[SK Telecom T1 2]] a month and a day before the two of them joined DetonatioN FocusMe.
* He has an excellent sense of gaming. Specifically, he has reached Radiant in valorant, Global Elite in CSGO, and the top of the Japanese leaderboard in Overwatch.
* He is well-known for his unique posture while playing, resulting in his face often being very close to the camera.
* He has won the most domestic championships of any player in Asia, with 16 as of 2026.
